title: Siamese invasion of Kedah
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siamese invasion of Kedah", at revision 1383040229, opens: "The Siamese invasion of Kedah was a military operation mounted by the Kingdom of Siam against the Sultanate of Kedah in November 1821, in the area of what is now northern Peninsular Malaysia." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q13012465, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1821 military operation". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
